title: Targeting the E3 ubiquitin ligase RNF10 ameliorates metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis in mice.
snippet: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) has emerged as a global health concern. Nevertheless, its underlying pathological mechanisms remain poorly understood.
